queryAndRequestOutcome: English and Amharic discovery identified official national geospatial/cadastral references and an Addis Ababa-only viewer, but no Irgalem or Sidama public parcel-vector service. Ethio-NSDI advertised WMS/WFS/REST capability without exposing a usable Irgalem layer or response. The Addis viewer HTML returned HTTP 200, while its current bundle timed out. Candidate regional hostnames failed DNS resolution.
